correctness.rationale: Decomposition into ordered-path step indicators is exact and yields a sharp norm because every C_n^m step image is monotone; strict positivity gives the positive-power rigidity. Markov first-step PGF recursion has correct base f_2=z/(2-z), factors into independent zero-based geometric PGFs, and therefore exactly equals the n-to-one absorption tail. Their variances and centered third moments satisfy a non-iid Berry–Esseen inequality giving the stated uniform O((log n)^(-1/2)) error. Standalone exact rational code checked 450 step/matrix identities, 18 PGF/moment cases and 5430 signed-input inequalities.

value.rationale: The natural finite variation contraction question for a classical averaging operator has an exact all-dimensional/all-power answer, a unique norming direction and a nontrivial dimension–iteration Gaussian cutoff. The log n center and sqrt(log n) transition width are motivated by finite-section stability and cannot be inferred from qualitative smoothing or a fixed-dimensional power limit. Neither arbitrary slices nor routine finite enumeration define the invariant.
